messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — v2 cutover canary slice starts tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final owners for: SDK patch, proxy header fallback, and docs redirects.
rajesh: I can own the proxy header fallback. I'll push the config change and smoke tests by EOD. tagging @samir for SDK compatibility.
samir: got it. PR opened: github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/4271 — still failing one test, needs one more reviewer. ETA: afternoon.
marta: I can do the review after lunch. One question: are we keeping `/v1/embeds` live until 2026-05-01 as discussed? docs need exact wording for deprecation notice.
elaine: yes — deprecation end date is 2026-05-01. Plan is 2-week redirect window post-cutover, then hard-deprecate. Docs should call out migration guide + quick CLI snippet.
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2026-03-20T16:00Z (slot 3) — automated smoke will run after deploy :white_check_mark:.
samir: flag — failing unit in `proxy/handler_test.go` around token propagation when KV store times out. Repro steps in PR comment.
rajesh: I have a mitigation ready: fall back to stateless `x-rdwd-token` header if KV is unavailable. I'll add the test that simulates KV timeout.
marta: also add a short note in the SDK changelog about breaking tweak to header order. Some clients depend on header precedence.
observability: noted — I'll create a temporary dashboard `v2_migration/quickpulse` with p50/p95 and error-rate. Will wire an alert if p95 > 500ms or error_rate > 1%.
elaine: important: rollback criteria = sustained error rate >5% for 5m or 20% increase in p95 vs baseline. Owners: please confirm you have an automated rollback + manual steps, reply with :thumbsup: if yes.
samir: :thumbsup: automated rollback hook in the PR pipeline ready, plus manual playbook steps in PR desc.
rajesh: :thumbsup: will include a note about rolling proxy config back first to avoid token mismatches.
marta: drafting the docs & changelog now, will post a PR for final copy within 2 hours.
elaine: thanks — if anyone discovers an untriaged compat snag, drop it here and call out severity. Leaving this thread for async check-ins; ping me if you need unblockers before morning standup.
